info.title: NullSquare AI Agent API
info.description: API for managing AI agent sessions, tasks, and user interactions.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the API server

tags.name: Findings
tags.description: Finding detail, evidence, and remediation context

tags.name: Integrations
tags.description: Organization integrations and GitHub repository mapping

tags.name: Model
tags.description: The one model the agent uses: ChatGPT plan, API key, or configuration file

get.description: Returns a paginated list of sessions for the authenticated user.
Model categories a session can use. Concrete models stay server-side and are resolved at session start.
Returns full details of a session including messages and plan.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a session and its data.

post.summary: Send a message to the session
post.description: Sends a user message to the AI agent session.

409.description: Message rejected by session state policy

post.description: Appends durable Start intent from any lifecycle state. Recovery waits automatically for unavailable prerequisites.

200.description: Start accepted or session already running

post.description: Appends durable Stop intent and interrupts current execution without deleting history.

get.description: Returns the execution plan for a session.
Returns messages for a session using opaque cursors for stable pagination.

schema.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page

get.description: Returns the health status of the API.
Returns detailed health information including database and service status.
Returns extended health information including sandbox status and dependencies.
Returns the profile for the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates or updates the user profile.

get.description: Returns the complete profile with all fields.
Returns the plan this computer runs on: the local plan, every feature and no limits.
Server-Sent Events stream for real-time session updates including messages and status changes.
Returns the tool catalog available to the agent.
Returns runs for the authenticated organization with optional scope, status, trigger, and limit filters.

post.description: Creates a goal-driven run and starts planner execution.
Pins the scope's code source (a clone's commit, or a folder's content hash) with its file manifest and git blob ids, and starts the dedicated read-only Code Review workflow.

400.description: No ready code source, or the path policy selects no files

403.description: Code Review entitlement or repository access denied

get.summary: Get canonical Code Review findings and report

post.summary: Request a fix for an agent-fixable finding
post.description: Creates an idempotent fix request for the current validated finding version. Patch generation and GitHub publication remain separate gated actions.

400.description: Risk source is stale, not confirmed, or not agent-fixable

403.description: Code Review or fix access denied

get.description: The folder or git URL the scope reads code from, its status (ready, cloning or failed) and the commit (a clone) or content hash (a folder) a Code Review would pin. Null when none is set.

put.description: Point the scope at an absolute folder path (validated, read in place, never written; inside NULL_AI_CODE_ROOT when set) or a public https:// or ssh git URL (cloned shallow in the background, at most 2 minutes and 200 MiB). Repeating the same git source does not clone again. No credentials are stored: a private repository is cloned by the person and added as a folder.

200.description: Folder scanned and ready, or the same git source already cloning or ready

202.description: Git clone started; poll GET until status is ready or failed

delete.description: Removes the source and its clone. A folder is never touched.

post.description: Re-scans a folder now, or fetches and resets a clone in the background.

404.description: The scope has no code source

post.description: Compiles an organization context brief from structured questionnaire answers. Response is plain text.

post.summary: Compile draft scope rules-of-engagement without persisted scope
post.description: Compiles a draft rules-of-engagement document from structured questionnaire answers and optional seed context. Response is plain text.
Compiles a scope rules-of-engagement document from structured questionnaire answers. Response is plain text.

get.summary: The connected model and the API-key providers
get.description: The one model the agent uses for every effort tier, or null. Never includes a key or a token.

delete.description: An API key is cleared. A ChatGPT plan is revoked and its tokens forgotten.

post.summary: Validate an API key and list its chat models
post.description: Lists the provider's models with the key (free), filtered to chat models, newest first. Saves nothing.

400.description: Invalid body, or the provider refused the key

502.description: The provider could not be reached or failed

post.summary: Connect the one model the agent uses
post.description: method api_key: provider, model and apiKey (omit apiKey to keep the connected key of the same provider). method chatgpt: a model of the signed-in ChatGPT plan.

400.description: Invalid body, refused key, or a model the key or plan does not offer

200.description: Plan models, in the server order

post.description: Returns the authorization URL to open in the browser. ChatGPT returns to http://127.0.0.1:<port of NULL_AI_APP_URL>/auth/callback (the app proxies it to GET /auth/callback), which stores the tokens and sends the browser to NULL_AI_APP_URL + returnTo with ?chatgpt=connected|no_plan|no_models|error.

get.description: The OAuth redirect (code, state, scope, client_id). Admitted by the one-time state, not the owner key. Redirects to the app, or answers a short HTML page.

200.description: HTML page (no app to return to)

400.description: HTML page explaining why the sign-in could not finish

post.description: One minimal streamed request through the client the agent uses. Times out after 20 s.

200.description: Result in plain words; never contains a key
